title: Answer
description:
He partook of real flesh and blood, the same humanity that returns to dust. He did not only appear among men.

Through death He destroys the one who had the power of death. Death is still appointed to men. What is destroyed is the bondage of fearing it, and the release is a death already died.

He does not give this aid to angels. He gives it to the seed of Abraham.

He is a merciful and faithful High Priest in things toward God, to make propitiation for the sins of the people. The office is already in view before a later name is given to it. Propitiation is toward God, for the people.

Because He Himself suffered and was tempted, He is able to aid those who are tempted. The temptation in view is the people’s testing and the Servant’s suffering, met in Him.
